title: Evaporation
body:
Evaporation cools a liquid because higher-energy molecules escape.

Less energy remains in the liquid after these molecules escape.

Humidity slows evaporation because more water vapor returns to the liquid.
rationale: Three short paragraphs are causal prose, not verse. Preserve the cooling mechanism and humidity distinction rather than manufacturing one exact-recitation card per line or repeating the same cooling answer twice.
